findings.codex_finding: EVIDENCE-SET-WORKFLOW.json:71-82 publishes a machine-readable receipt.binds list containing only the seven v1.14 fields. Runtime location_receipt (authority_lib.py:302) binds ten fields, additionally including workflow_path, workflow_sha256 and evidence_snapshot_digest. Adjacent prose accurately claims those bindings, so executable enforcement is stronger than the stale machine list and no false authorization was demonstrated. Nevertheless the frozen machine authority gives an incomplete receipt domain and must be corrected before merge. Add the exact three active fields and add bidirectional code/document parity validation. Affected gate: MERGE.
findings.prior_defect: Reproduced against the frozen v1.15 bundle: EVIDENCE-SET-WORKFLOW.json#core_authority.receipt.binds == ['session_id','document_path','governed_root','authority_version','manifest_sha256','document_sha256','location_validated'] (7), while authority_lib.location_receipt digested ['session_id','document_path','workflow_path','governed_root','authority_version','manifest_sha256','document_sha256','workflow_sha256','evidence_snapshot_digest','location_validated'] (10). The three omitted fields are exactly workflow_path and workflow_sha256 (added by v1.15 V114-B4, which made WORKFLOW.json governed evidence) and evidence_snapshot_digest (added by v1.15 V114-B1, the digest of the parse of the validated bytes). A consumer recomputing the receipt from frozen machine authority would have digested seven fields and disagreed with every receipt the authority mints.
findings.correction: The publication is GENERATED from the runtime instead of written beside it. tools/authority_lib.py#RECEIPT_BOUND_FIELDS declares the ten fields in digest order and location_receipt() now ASSEMBLES its digest body from that tuple, raising RECEIPT_BINDING_DRIFT if the assembled body and the declared tuple ever disagree, so the declared set and the digested set are one thing rather than two. #RECEIPT_FIELD_SEMANTICS adds the operational semantics of every field - source, normative, in_digest, revalidated_live, consumed_by_authorizing_core - and #receipt_binding_publication() generates the machine publication that both EVIDENCE-SET-WORKFLOW.json#core_authority.receipt and AUTHORITY-FUNCTION-CLASSES.json#receipt_binding are produced from. M0A-BINDING-VALUES.json publishes the field list, the field count, the two artifact paths and the package update requirement, so Hermes can derive the exact runtime receipt field set without inspecting Python. The receipt DOMAIN vidtoolz.resolveLocationReceipt.v1 is unchanged and the evidence-set snapshot domain remains distinct: documentation catching up with the runtime is not a contract change, and no receipt semantics were redesigned.
